name: WPC Email Preview and Log for WooCommerce
author: WPClever

sections.description:
WPC Email Preview and Log is an essential tool for WooCommerce store owners and developers. It allows you to easily preview your WooCommerce email templates, send test emails to verify their appearance, and keep a detailed log of all your outgoing website emails.

Whether you are customizing your WooCommerce email templates and need to see how they look with actual order data, or you need to troubleshoot email delivery issues by checking the logs of all emails sent from your site, this plugin provides a clean, integrated, and reliable solution.

Key Features

  • WooCommerce Email Preview: Preview any WooCommerce email template (New Order, Processing Order, Completed Order, etc.) using real data from existing orders in your store.
  • Send Test Emails: Quickly send a test email of the previewed template to your own email address to check how it renders in different email clients.
  • Comprehensive Email Logging: Logs all outgoing emails sent from your WordPress site via wp_mail, including WooCommerce emails and core WordPress notifications.
  • Detailed Log Information: View the status of each email (Sent or Failed), recipient address, subject, headers, attachments, and the actual HTML content of the email directly from your dashboard.
  • Seamless Integration: Integrates perfectly into the WooCommerce admin menu with a dedicated “Email Preview” page and an “Email Logs” section.
  • Ajax-Powered Interface: Search for orders, preview emails, and send tests quickly without reloading the page.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the wpc-email-preview-and-log folder to your /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install it directly through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to WooCommerce > Email Preview to start previewing your email templates.
  4. Go to WooCommerce > Email Logs to view the history of outgoing emails.
sections.faq:
How do I preview an email?

Navigate to WooCommerce > Email Preview. Select the email template you want to preview from the dropdown, then search and select an existing order to populate the email with real data. Click “Preview”.

How do I view email logs?

Navigate to WooCommerce > Email Logs. Here you will see a list of all emails sent from your site along with their delivery status (Sent or Failed). Click on any log entry to view the full details and the HTML content of the email.

Does it log emails sent by other plugins?

Yes. The plugin hooks into the standard WordPress wp_mail function, meaning it will log any email sent by WordPress core, WooCommerce, or other plugins using the standard mailing method.
